newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre declines comment on Goodyear talks.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre declines comment on Goodyear talks.

text.p: China's Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co Ltd declined to comment on Monday on news reports that it is in talks about the possible sale of a portion of its state shares to Goodyear Tire and Rubber Co.

A spokesman said all its state shares were owned by Shanghai Chemical Industry Holding Co and it was up to the holding firm to comment. Officials at Shanghai Chemical Industry were not immediately available.

News reports said Goodyear was in talks to buy 25 to 30 percent of the Shanghai firm's outstanding 561.6 million state-owned shares. Shanghai stock analysts said they believed such a deal was very unlikely to be approved in the short term.
China's securities regulations have no provision governing the purchase of state shares in listed firms by foreign companies and so far there has been no such case.
Last year, two Japanese companies bought a large quantity of state-owned institutional shares in Beijing Lightbus Co Ltd.
Though the securities authorities finally agreed to the deal, they nevertheless issued an urgent circular to listed firms, banning any more such deals before relevant regulations were promulgated.
